messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 16):
"""
A withdrawn Individual Health Insurance product/add-on/rider shall not be offered to new customers after the date of the withdrawal. 5. The existing customers of a withdrawn product shall be provided the following options: a. A one-time option to renew the existing product, if renewal falls within the 90 days from the date of withdrawal of the product; or b. Migrate to any other suitable product (any other existing product or modified version of the withdrawn product) as per the choice of the policyholder 6. Any Individual or Group Health Insurance Product offered with a term exceeding one year, shall be continued on the agreed terms for all the existing policyholders for the entire policy term. Provided in case of Group Health Insurance Product, the PMC shall put in place guidelines for withdrawal.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If a health insurance product is withdrawn, how long do existing policyholders have to renew it before they must choose another option?","answer":"Existing customers have a one‑time option to renew the product only if the renewal falls within 90 days from the date of withdrawal.","facts":["A one‑time option to renew the existing product, if renewal falls within the 90 days from the date of withdrawal of the product"]},{"question":"What must a Group Health Insurance Product’s PMC do if the product is withdrawn?","answer":"The PMC must establish guidelines for withdrawal of the product.","facts":["Provided in case of Group Health Insurance Product, the PMC shall put in place guidelines for withdrawal"]}]}
